arguments.content:
# Candidate: raw-value {{workspace:task/sana-farid/langfuse-15208-histogram}} binning

Fixes issue #15208 by computing min, range, and bucket membership from raw scores while retaining two-decimal rounding only for display labels. Adds the seven-bin 0.857 regression and an integer-score preservation case.

Validation: targeted Vitest command attempted, but the mounted snapshot has no Node/pnpm executable. Static review confirms only {{workspace:task/sana-farid/langfuse-15208-histogram}} arithmetic and its focused unit test changed.

Evidence: /code/upstream-issues/langfuse-15208.md; /code/langfuse/web/src/features/widgets/chart-library/ARCHITECTURE.md.

# Candidate: count-weighted average rollups

Fixes issue #15208 by recombining grouped averages as sum(avg * count) / sum(count) when a count metric is present. Rows missing either member are excluded; zero total count returns zero. Without a count metric, the documented legacy unweighted mean remains. Count/sum/min/max/percentile behavior is unchanged.

Focused regressions cover unequal groups, fallback without counts, subtotal/grand-total behavior, missing paired values, and empty data.

Validation: targeted Vitest command attempted, but the mounted snapshot has no Node/pnpm executable. Evidence: /code/upstream-issues/langfuse-15208.md; Quality Metrics Observability Standard dsid_84a9dac9a58d4626aaf08ec637efbff7.

arguments.summary: Histogram membership must be computed from raw numeric observations; rounding is presentation-only for display labels. Averages of pre-aggregated groups must be recombined as sum(group_average * group_count) / sum(group_count) when a count metric is available. If no count metric is present, retain an explicit unweighted-mean fallback. Non-average aggregations remain unchanged.
